inputs.question: REPLACE_ME with a question your documents answer, e.g. "What are the opening hours of the visitor centre?"

expectations.expected_response: REPLACE_ME with the fact from your documents that a correct answer must support, e.g. "The visitor centre is open 9am to 5pm, seven days a week."
